notes: All periods discovery. No thresholds or replay.
Peak is original AE3 preceding high. Origin is lowest low among exactly N earlier same-session candles, latest tie. Full windows only.
Magnitude uses wick extrema and decision close; efficiency uses closes, not assumed intrabar paths. Ratios are proxies, not proof of genuine reversal.
Authorization features only for authorized warnings; retrospective price proxies use next open and six subsequent bars; not executable outcomes.
